question: Should QQBot introduce `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` as a supported plugin-owned data-root override, or should the diagnostic stop recommending that env var?
rationale: OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new env/config surface, and recent QQBot storage work moved persistent runtime state toward SQLite while the current diagnostic already created user expectations around `QQBOT_DATA_DIR`.

options.title: Support the env override
options.body: Make `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` a documented plugin-owned env surface with trimming, normalization, path-safety validation, focused tests, docs, and real diagnostic proof.

options.title: Remove the recommendation
options.body: Change QQBot diagnostics to recommend an existing supported recovery path instead of adding another env-controlled storage root.

options.title: Defer to storage cleanup
options.body: Keep this open until the remaining legacy data-directory uses are retired or formally migrated, then decide whether a custom root is still needed.

recommendation.title: Support the env override
recommendation.body: Make `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` a documented plugin-owned env surface with trimming, normalization, path-safety validation, focused tests, docs, and real diagnostic proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent SQLite migration makes this primarily a QQBot storage-contract decision, and that history is closest to the unresolved product boundary.
